title: Direct Questions
instructions: Вы получите рекламное объявление. Подготовьтесь задать 4 прямых вопроса по плану. На подготовку даётся 1,5 минуты.

tasks.title: Cooking Masterclass
tasks.adTitle: Let's teach everyone how to cook!
tasks.prompt: You are considering going to the cooking masterclass and now you'd like to get more information. In 1.5 minutes you are to ask four direct questions to find out about the following:
questions: kinds of dishes taught at the masterclass
size of the group (number of people)
